title: Kota Belud Half Marathon 2026 Review: Sabah's Bajau-Homeland 21K
seo_title: Kota Belud Half Marathon 2026 Review | Sabah Malaysia Race
meta_description: The Kota Belud Half Marathon 2026: November 8 in Kota Belud, Sabah. A 21.1K in the heartland of Sabah's Bajau community — registration open.
dek: Set for 8 November 2026 in Kota Belud, Sabah — the cultural heartland of Borneo's 'Cowboys of the East' — this half marathon offers a single-distance 21.1K with registration open.
verdict: The Kota Belud Half Marathon brings a road race to one of Sabah's most culturally distinctive districts — the homeland of the Bajau people, known as the 'Cowboys of the East' for their equestrian traditions. A single-distance 21.1K with registration open. Kota Belud sits roughly 70km northeast of Kota Kinabalu, at the foot of Mount Kinabalu with views of the Crocker Range. November is the tail of the drier period on Sabah's west coast. A distinctive, community-flavoured Sabah half marathon for runners wanting a Borneo race off the tourist trail.

sections.heading: Kota Belud: The Land of the Bajau Cowboys
paragraphs: Kota Belud is renowned as the cultural heartland of Sabah's Bajau community, famous for their horse-riding traditions and the annual Tamu Besar market festival. [1] The district sits on a coastal plain with views of Mount Kinabalu — a distinctive Borneo backdrop for a half marathon.
